column2: BUG severity=HIGH — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs "export const DEFAULT_TABLE = path.join(HERE, 'rule-lists.json');" — the new launch and close code depend on a data file this diff does not add (cannot see `scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` in the pasted diff); if it is absent, `readTable` throws and `backlog-lane` refuses every launch, while check-lane-close's `if (!fs.existsSync(tableFile)) { ... return 0 }` makes the whole hook a silent no-op (fails open) — confirm the JSON is committed in this change, not assumed.

DEFER severity=MED — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs ".filter((f) => { const p = f.split('/'); return p.length === 6 && p[4] === laneName; });" — lane report discovery matches the assignee name case-sensitively, while every other identity comparison in the file goes through `norm` (which lowercases); an assignee `@lane-Alice` with directory `alice` finds no files and refuses with a misleading "no compliance output" — normalize the directory segment before comparing (e.g. `norm(p[4]) === norm(laneName)`).

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs "if (!files.some((f) => /^plan-.+\.txt$/.test(f.name))) errors.push(" — the plan-stage gate is satisfied by any `plan-*.txt`, and `plan-compliance-<id>.txt` matches it, so a build task whose only plan output is compliance passes the "plan reviewed before the build" check even though no `plan-review-deepseek`/`plan-error-paths` lens ran — exclude `plan-compliance-*` or require the specific `set.plan` files.

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs "return imps.some((i) => new RegExp(`(?:from\\s*|require\\s*\\(\\s*|import\\s*\\(\\s*)['\"][^'\"]*${i.replace(" — the `[^'\"]*` prefix lets `imports_from` match a substring of a module specifier, so `imports_from: ['auth']` also matches `from './oauth'` or `from '@x/author'`, wrongly attaching the row's lists — anchor the module path (whole specifier or glob) instead of an unanchored suffix.

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs "const row = d && d.types.map((x) => x.toLowerCase()).includes(String(type ?? '').toLowerCase())" — `validateTable` never checks that `no_files_default.types` is an array, so a malformed table throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')` (caught upstream as a raw TypeError) rather than a clean validation message — validate `types` in `validateTable`, or guard `Array.isArray(d.types)` here.

DEFER severity=LOW — scripts/analysis/backlog-lane.mjs "root: board, body: t.body, type: String(t.fm.type ?? ''), letter: milestoneLetter(board, t.fm.milestone)" — the Files line is now read from `t.body` for the rule lists and lens set, while the neighbouring code still reads `descriptionOf(t)` for `goal`; if `t.body` and `descriptionOf(t)` are not the same field the two paths resolve different Files text — use `descriptionOf(t)` (or the same accessor) so launch, lens set and close agree.

BUG severity=HIGH — 08_agents.md 5.3 dated note 2026-11-20 item (1) "`scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` is the path to rule-list table: data, not code, says which rule lists (whole files, or whole sections where the file itself separates rules from history) govern a touched path" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:21 "export const DEFAULT_TABLE = path.join(HERE, 'rule-lists.json');" — the table itself is not in this diff, yet backlog-lane.mjs:73 loads it before any write with no fallback, so no row, no `globs_from` map and none of the specs 126, 127, 128 or Spec 135 rows the ruling says go into the path table are shown, and every launch refuses with "cannot read the rule-list table" unless the file already ships — add scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json (rows, why, globs_from, no_files_default, increment_docs) to this diff together with the readers.

BUG severity=HIGH — 08_agents.md 5.3 dated note item (3) "refuses a commit that sets a lane's task BUILT or DONE unless `docs/reports/lanes/<date>/<lane>/` holds one compliance lens output per attached list and a `GROUNDER.md` whose `Grounder:` is not the `Lane:`" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:83 "if (!(build || findings.length > 0)) return errors;" — a task that is not build or fix and whose lens outputs carry no BUG/DEFER line closes with no GROUNDER.md at all, which the clause does not permit (it states no type exemption) — require GROUNDER.md on every close, or get the record-only exemption written into the ruling before merge.

DEFER severity=MED — 08_agents.md 5.3 dated note item (3) "with one `<finding id> CONFIRMED|REJECTED <file:line> [reason]` line per BUG or DEFER finding of the lens outputs; presence and form only" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:110 "if (v.quote.trim().length < 6) { errors.push(`GROUNDER.md: finding ${f.id}: the quote must be 6+ characters taken from ${v.file}:${v.line}`); continue; }" — the check demands a 6+ character quoted quote and admits a third verdict word CONFLICT, neither of which the clause's form has, so a GROUNDER.md line written exactly in the clause form is refused as "no complete verdict line" — accept the clause form (quote and reason optional where the clause makes them so) or amend the ruling's line form to match the check.

DEFER severity=MED — 08_agents.md 5.3 dated note item (2) "puts the governing lists into the brief (READ each whole before planning) and runs the compliance lens once per list with the list pasted whole ahead of the plan or diff (`scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs lens-input`" — scripts/analysis/backlog-lane.mjs:23 "import { DEFAULT_TABLE, filesText, lensSet, milestoneLetter, readTable, resolveTask } from './rule-lists.mjs';" — the launch never calls lens-input or buildLensInputs; it only writes prose into the brief (line 147) telling the agent to run it, so the "runs the compliance lens once per list" half is delegated to prose and nothing at launch executes or checks it — invoke lens-input per list at launch, or have the ruling say the brief's command is the run.

DEFER severity=MED — 08_agents.md 5.3 dated note item (2) "refuses a task with no Files line (a record-only task gets the queue lists) or an unmatched path with the path named" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:201 "return { error: `refused: no increment requirements document for milestone group [${letter}] in increment_docs of scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` };" — a third, unnamed launch refusal: any task whose milestone group letter has no increment_docs entry cannot be launched at all, a gate no pasted clause or operator verbatim names — drop the gate, or add the increment-document requirement to the ruling and the table before launch depends on it.

BUG severity=HIGH — §11.1 "A plan or fold may not contain a claim that COULD be executed but wasn't" and §7 rule 4 "run the LENS SET in parallel, each a narrow prompt" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:28 "export const DEFAULT_TABLE = path.join(HERE, 'rule-lists.json');" — the diff adds both readers of scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json and the spec line claiming the table exists, but not the table itself, so backlog-lane.mjs readTable throws ENOENT and refuses every launch and check-lane-close.mjs returns 0, so neither the lens set nor the close lock runs — add scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json to the diff and show node scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs validate green

DEFER severity=MED — §7 rule 4 "Run the set at plan AND output for WF1/WF2; at output for WF3." — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:55 "const phases = build ? ['out'] : ['plan', 'out'];" — a build or fix task closes without any plan-phase compliance output per list (the generic plan-*.txt may be plan-review-deepseek) and a record-only task can close with plan only, so neither altitude matches rule 4 — require plan-compliance-<list id>.txt and out-compliance-<list id>.txt for build/fix, out only for record-only, or file the DEFER with reason

DEFER severity=MED — §7 rule 10 dated note 2026-11-19 "The lane close step copies the lane's REPORT.md (and its TRIAGE.md and the review output, when they exist) into docs/reports/lanes/<date>/<lane>/" — scripts/analysis/backlog-lane.mjs:152 "copy plan-*.txt, out-*.txt and FINDINGS.md into docs/reports/lanes/<date>/<lane>/" — the brief instructs an unnamed FINDINGS.md and omits REPORT.md and TRIAGE.md, and the close check requires neither — name REPORT.md and TRIAGE.md in the copy instruction and drop FINDINGS.md or cite the clause that authorises it

DEFER severity=MED — §7 rule 4 "Every DeepSeek finding is adjudicated by a tool-having grounder before folding" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:20 "every docs/reports/lanes/*/<lane>/ counts (no date is computed)" — the close check reads every date's outputs for the lane, so a later task close that adds no new outputs reuses an earlier close's compliance outputs and GROUNDER.md and passes without its own findings adjudicated — require the outputs to be added or modified in the closing task's commit or in the commit date dir

DEFER severity=MED — §11.2 "one grounder re-executes every claim in the fold + one cross-read adversary checks the folded decisions PAIRWISE" — .claude/review-templates/README.md:141 "The grounder, an agent that is not the lane and not any assignee of the task, writes `GROUNDER.md`" — only the grounder pass is mandated, no cross-read or pairwise check is required, so the fold-validation step is half-built — add a cross-read adversary output and require it at close, or record why it is DEFER

DEFER severity=LOW — §7 rule 7 "Security fires only on money/auth/PII/admin" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:109 "const sec = /entitlement|auth|stripe|metered/i.test(files);" — an admin or PII surface never gets the security lens though rule 7 names admin and PII as triggers — add admin and pii to the regex

DEFER severity=LOW — §7 rule 6 "Findings triage (WF6): BUG → WF3 before Green Light; DEFER → review_followups.md with reasons." — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:127 "if (v.word !== 'CONFIRMED' && !v.reason)" — a CONFIRMED DEFER needs no reason and no review_followups.md entry, so the DEFER half of rule 6 is not enforced at close — require each CONFIRMED DEFER to name its review_followups.md line

BUG severity=HIGH — 5.3 Red-Green Test Cycle "You MUST write and run a **failing test** (Red Light) BEFORE writing any feature or fix code. Code may not be written until the test demonstrably fails." — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:2 "COMPLY.2 (task-366): the path to rule-list table reader." — the diff lands 306 lines of new derivation logic plus a 162-line commit gate and not a single test file appears anywhere in it, so no red light can have been run for any of it — add the failing test first (resolveTask refusals, sectionText single-match, splitUnits, findingsIn ordinals) in a `*.logic.test.ts`, run it red, then implement.

BUG severity=HIGH — 5.2 "`*.logic.test.ts` | Pure functions, scoring, classification | Any pure/derivation logic" and 5.5 "Un-pinned derivation logic silently changes value." — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:122 "export function lensSet({ type, files }) {" — which lenses a task must run, which rule lists attach, and which finding ids the close gate demands are pure derivations (lensSet, resolveTask, filesEntries, findingsIn, sectionText, splitUnits) with no pinning test, so a change here silently alters what is gated with a green suite — add `rule-lists.logic.test.ts` for those functions plus a `check-lane-close` fixture test (missing GROUNDER.md, edited output hash, quote not on the cited line).

DEFER severity=MED — 5.2 "generated doc ↔ its generator (the drift guard, regenerate to a buffer, diff the committed file)" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:86 "bad.push(`list ${id}: generated_by missing" — validate only asserts that a generator path is named; nothing regenerates a generated list and diffs it, so a list produced by a script can drift from its generator while validate prints ok — add a parity check or test that runs each named generator to a buffer and refuses on a diff with the committed list file.

DEFER severity=MED — 14 registry "traceability rot; stale cross-refs" / "Every source/test file's `SPEC LINK` points at the spec AND the section (§N)" — scripts/analysis/backlog-lane.mjs:152 "Spec 08 section 7 rule 4, 08_agents.md:334" — the same diff inserts a two-line dated note into docs/specs/00-architecture/08_agents.md (at line 229), shifting the 08_agents.md:334 and :339 line citations the new and edited code still rely on — re-point those citations at section numbers, or re-check the line numbers after the insert, in this commit.

DEFER severity=LOW — 14 registry "new couplings update **Cross-Spec Dependencies both directions**" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:10 "// Rules: Spec 08 section 7 rule 4 and section 5.3 (08_agents.md), 00_engineering_standards.md section 14" — the header states the specs in prose rather than a `SPEC LINK` marker, and no Cross-Spec Dependencies edit for the scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json coupling appears in the diff (cannot see whether those sections exist elsewhere) — add a `SPEC LINK:` line naming spec and section to both new files and the cross-spec entries for Spec 08 and Spec 137.

BUG severity=HIGH — eng-s5 §5.3 "You MUST write and run a **failing test** (Red Light) BEFORE writing any feature or fix code. Code may not be written until the test demonstrably fails." — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:21 "export const DEFAULT_TABLE = path.join(HERE, 'rule-lists.json');" — none of the 468 new lines (rule-lists.mjs, check-lane-close.mjs) has a test in this diff, and the table that line points at is not in the diff either, so the launch path backlog-lane.mjs now refuses on is never exercised — write and run the failing test first (resolveTask refusals, findingsIn ordinals, buildLensInputs bound), run `rule-lists.mjs validate` against the committed table, paste the Red output.

BUG severity=HIGH — eng-s5 §5.2 "`*.logic.test.ts` | Pure functions, scoring, classification | Any pure/derivation logic" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:168 "export function resolveTask({ table, root, body, type, letter, tracked }) {" — all new derivation (resolveTask, headings/sectionText, splitUnits, findingsIn, lensSet, closeErrors) ships with no *.logic.test.ts in the diff, so the refusal paths and the finding ordinals are unproven — add rule-lists.logic.test.ts pinning the no-Files refusal, the unmatched-path refusal, a selector matching two headings, and BUG/DEFER ordinal ids.

DEFER severity=MED — eng-s5 §5.5 parity battery "Two parallel implementations stay in sync (§7 dual-path; seed-JSON ↔ TS defaults; generated doc ↔ generator)" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:30 "const VERDICT = /^\s*[-*]?\s*(\S+)\s+(CONFIRMED|REJECTED|CONFLICT)\s+" vs docs/specs/00-architecture/08_agents.md:230 "one `<finding id> CONFIRMED|REJECTED <file:line> [reason]` line per BUG or DEFER finding" — the verdict grammar is restated in the README, Spec 08, Spec 137 and the launch brief, with CONFLICT in some and absent in Spec 08, and no drift guard pins them — pin the word list once and add a parity test (or generate the doc sentence from the hook's list).

DEFER severity=MED — eng-s5 §5.5 "A load-bearing behavior (a documented fence, a past `fix(...)` ...) is preserved across a change." — scripts/lib/review-template.js:75 "// task-366 (COMPLY.2): ONE pass with function replacers, so a value is inserted literally: no dollar-sequence expansion and no re-scan of inserted text for tokens." — this retires the three-pass replace that every lens prompt runs through and pins nothing (cannot see whether the Regression Guardian flagged it) — add a *.regression.test.ts feeding a material containing `$&` and `{{PLAN}}` and assert both survive literally, run red before the change.

BUG severity=HIGH — operator ruling 2026-11-20 as cited in the material, "yes to McStorage and 1,2,3 yes as recommended" (the surface specs 126, 127, 128 and the full Spec 135 rows go into the path table) — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:2 "COMPLY.2 (task-366): the path to rule-list table reader. DATA (scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json), not code, decides which rule lists govern a task." — the path table the cited ruling puts the specs 126, 127, 128 and the Spec 135 rows into is absent from the diff, so the ruling is unmet and both readers load a file that does not exist — add scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json (rows for 126/127/128, the Spec 135 rows, increment_docs, exempt, no_files_default) in this same change.

BUG severity=HIGH — docs/specs/00-architecture/08_agents.md added note in the material, "`scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` is the path to rule-list table: data, not code, says which rule lists (whole files, or whole sections where the file itself separates rules from history) govern a touched path" — scripts/analysis/backlog-lane.mjs:72 "try { resolved = resolveTask({ table: readTable(path.resolve(home(str('rule-lists', DEFAULT_TABLE)))), root: board, body: t.body," — with no table in the tree readTable throws and the catch refuses before any write, so this commit refuses every lane launch, which the note's own claim (built in the repo) does not allow — ship the table, or fall back to the table in HEAD, in the same commit.

DEFER severity=MED — operator ruling 2026-11-20 as cited in the material, "Add the tasks to incr 1b - the infa freeze needs to be lifted again - what is the point of building a mess - wasted effort." — NONE — no hunk adds any task to an increment document (no backlog/tasks or backlog/docs/increments change), the diff only asserts the freeze is lifted "by name" in two dated notes — add the COMPLY.2 tasks to the Increment 1b document within this change.

DEFER severity=MED — pasted rule list inc-S, "counts: {"BUILT":42,"BUILT-NO-DATA":7,"NOT BUILT":16}" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:2 "COMPLY.2 close check (task-366; Spec 08 section 7 rule 4 and section 5.3, 08_agents.md:" — the pasted Increment S list names no rule-list table, lens input, close hook or review template, so the material adds behaviour no pasted clause names and this paste cannot judge it — attach the list that governs .claude/review-templates, scripts/analysis and scripts/hooks and re-run before a compliance verdict is claimed.

BUG severity=HIGH — doc-17 header "They are NOT the operator's words as a ruling and never feed a review as a ruling (Spec 137 rule 10; register rule of 2026-11-18). The operator's rulings are the decisions." — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:74 "if (list.whole) return [{ label: 'whole file', text: text.endsWith('\n') ? text : `${text}\n` }];" — nothing in the table reader or in `validateTable` tests that a registered list is rulings and not readings, so a whole-file list such as this document is pasted whole as the governing clause set of a review (this very review's input is doc-17 passed whole as its rules), which the pasted header forbids — refuse a list whose head carries the readings header (or require a rulings-only section selector in the table) and re-issue this review against rulings.

BUG severity=HIGH — RR-0110 "Infra freeze: no new infra tasks; a gap is fixed only if it blocks a project commit (2026-11-02; memory record)" with the only pasted lift RR-0001 "Infra freeze lifted for the named list only; scratch-side parts now, repo checks after push 6" — .husky/commit-msg:8 "+node scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs \"$1\" && \" and docs/specs/00-architecture/08_agents.md:229 "the infra freeze is lifted for it by name" — the change adds new repo-wide infra (a commit-msg gate that can refuse any commit) and rests its lift on an operator quote dated 2026-11-20 that is not in the pasted context while the pasted lift covers "the named list only" and that named list cannot be seen — paste the 2026-11-20 words and the named list that includes task-366, or hold the hook and the spec notes out of the repo commit.

DEFER severity=MED — rule-lists.mjs:166 "Returns {lists, exempt, unmatched} on success, {error} (one line) when refused: no Files line, an unmatched path, or no increment document." — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:200 "if (letter !== undefined) {" — when the milestone title carries no [group] letter the increment document check is skipped silently instead of refused, so a task launched from such a milestone attaches no increment requirements document and the close check never misses it — always require an increment document, mapping a missing letter to a named default or a refusal.

DEFER severity=MED — docs/specs/00-architecture/08_agents.md:229 "with one `<finding id> CONFIRMED|REJECTED <file:line> [reason]` line per BUG or DEFER finding" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:30 "const VERDICT = /^\s*[-*]?\s*(\S+)\s+(CONFIRMED|REJECTED|CONFLICT)\s+(\S+?):(\d+)\s+\"([^\"]*)\"\s*(.*)$/;" — the spec clause the lane is held to names a two-word verdict set while the hook accepts and reasons a third, CONFLICT, so a grounder that follows the spec note exactly is not what the hook checks — add CONFLICT (and its reason duty) to the spec note, or drop CONFLICT from the hook.

DEFER severity=MED — .claude/review-templates/README.md:138 "**The table.** `scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` maps path globs to rule lists" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:150 "return 0; // a repo that never had the table is not held to it" — the table the whole design rests on is not in this diff (cannot see it, its rows or its increment_docs), and the close check fails open when it never existed in HEAD, so at this commit none of the stated close requirements fire — add scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json to the change and show `rule-lists.mjs validate` passing over it.

DEFER severity=LOW — .claude/review-templates/README.md:142 "each ends with a `VERDICT:` line" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:74 "else if (!/^VERDICT:/m.test(t)) errors.push(`${id}: ${n} has no VERDICT line (a failed run is not a lens output)`);" — the check matches a VERDICT line anywhere in the file, not the end, so a run truncated after its verdict still passes as a whole lens output — anchor the test to the last non-empty line, or soften the README to "holds a VERDICT: line".

BUG severity=HIGH — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "Which lists a task attaches is decided by `scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json` from the task's Files line" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:153 "return 0; // a repo that never had the table is not held to it" — the data file the clause names is not in this diff (only its reader, scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs, is), so until rule-lists.json lands in HEAD every close of a lane task passes unrefused, and the clause's "scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs refuses the commit that sets BUILT or DONE without them" is unmet — add scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json to this same commit and fail closed when it is absent from HEAD instead of returning 0.

BUG severity=HIGH — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "`scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs` refuses the commit that sets BUILT or DONE without them" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:131 "if (!m) return 0;" — the hook only runs when the message carries a `Task: task-N` trailer, and the code trailer check (G3) demands one only for src/scripts/mobile/migrations commits, so a docs or spec commit that flips a task to BUILT or DONE is never checked — locate the staged `backlog/tasks/<id> - ...` file from the diff itself and run the check on the status move, not on the trailer.

BUG severity=MED — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "(the launch refuses a task whose Files line is missing or matches no row)" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:180 "the task has no Files: line, so no rule lists can be attached (add \"Files: path, dir/, glob\" to the description; only a ${d ? d.types.join('/') : 'record-only'} task defaults to the queue lists)" — a task whose Files line is missing is launched with the queue lists instead of being refused, so the clause's refusal does not hold for record-only types — either refuse every task without a Files line or add the Spec 08 parenthetical "a record-only task gets the queue lists" to the Spec 137 note.

DEFER severity=MED — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "now also needs, in the repo copy of the lane report (`docs/reports/lanes/<date>/<lane>/`), one compliance lens output per rule list the task attaches and a `GROUNDER.md` from an agent that is not the lane, with a verdict line per finding" — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:148 "but has no @lane-* assignee, so there is no lane report to check" — the hook also refuses on a missing @lane assignee, on the code lens set (out-code-review, out-error-paths, out-ux, out-security) and on a missing plan-*.txt, none of which the clause names — name those refusals in the Spec 137 note or drop them from the hook, so the clause and the gate say the same thing.

DEFER severity=MED — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "(the launch refuses a task whose Files line is missing or matches no row)" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:205 "refused: no increment requirements document for milestone group [${letter}] in increment_docs of scripts/analysis/rule-lists.json" — the launch adds a third refusal, an increment document per milestone group, that no pasted clause names and that .claude/review-templates/README.md does not list among the table keys — document increment_docs and no_files_default in the README table description and name the refusal in the note, or drop it.

DEFER severity=LOW — Spec 137 §4 note 2026-11-20 "with a verdict line per finding" — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:213 "export const FINDING_LINE = /^\s*[-*]?\s*(BUG|DEFER)\s+severity=/;" — a finding a lens writes in any other form is invisible to findingsIn, so it gets no verdict line and the close still passes, while the clause reads per finding — make the line form binding on every lens template the gate accepts, or widen the pattern and say so.

BUG severity=HIGH — scripts/hooks/check-lane-close.mjs:44 "const textOf = (n) => files.find((f) => f.name === n)?.text;" — lane files are collected from every docs/reports/lanes/*/<lane>/ date dir and matched by basename only, so a later close by the same lane name is satisfied by an earlier task's outputs and GROUNDER.md (the Ruled hashes recompute against those same stale files, and the finding ids come from them too), zero new lens work, silently — scope the report dir to the task (docs/reports/lanes/<date>/<lane>/<task-id>/) or refuse when a required basename appears in more than one date dir

BUG severity=MED — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:27 "const r = spawnSync('git', ['-c', 'core.quotepath=false', 'ls-files', '-z'], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });" — the commit-msg gate calls git with no timeout (same in check-lane-close.mjs:25), so a stalled git on a network or FUSE checkout hangs every commit with no bound and no message — pass timeout: 20000 and treat a killed child as a refusal that names the timeout

BUG severity=MED — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:198 "if (letter !== undefined) {" — when milestoneLetter returns undefined (task with no milestone, milestone file not found, or a title with no trailing [X]) the increment requirements document is silently not attached at launch or close, while the launch still files the task under group F (backlog-lane.mjs:167 groups: [letter ?? 'F']), so an F task closes with no F increment list — resolve the letter once and refuse (or default to F) on both sides so a missing letter cannot drop the increment list

BUG severity=MED — scripts/analysis/rule-lists.mjs:207 "export const FINDING_LINE = /^\s*[-*]?\s*(BUG|DEFER)\s+severity=/;" — a lens that emits a bolded or colon-form finding line (for example **BUG** severity=CRIT or BUG: severity=CRIT) counts as findings:0, so on a non build/fix task GROUNDER.md is not required at all and on a build/fix task no verdict line is required, and the Ruled count recomputed here agrees with the miss — refuse an output whose BUG/DEFER text yields no parseable finding, or widen the matcher and keep the count strict
